title: Ultimate 5000 Bar Salt Plum Berry 10ml E-Liquid By Ultimate Juice
description: Ultimate 5000 Bar Salt's Plum Berry e-liquid weaves the deep, rich taste of ripe plums with a vibrant medley of sweet berries, creating a luscious blend that's both complex and delightfully comforting. This e-liquid's intricate flavour profile offers a sumptuous vape experience, with the plums providing a juicy base that's perfectly accented by the tart and sweet notes of assorted berries. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between rich flavour and ample cloud production, while the Nicotine Salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod vape devices . Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, it caters to both moderate and high nicotine preferences. Nicotine salts’ unique alkaline formulation allows for a higher concentration of nicotine without the harshness, delivering a smoother throat hit compared to high-strength freebase liquids. They are absorbed into the bloodstream faster, providing near-instant relief from nicotine cravings, making Nic salt e-liquids a superior choice for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking immediate satisfaction. Inspired by the intense and super-satisfying flavours of the brand’s bestselling Ultimate Bar disposable vape devices, the Ultimate 5000 Bar Salt range includes a collection of 20 irresistible flavours that span classic favourites as well as exciting new blends, ensuring a premium vaping experience for every palate.
